title: The Era of Agentic Security
takeaways: Exploration of how generative AI and autonomous agents are changing security operations.
The presentation focuses on governance in an age of autonomy.

title: It's not who can build now, it is who you trust - From Creator to Curator Economy
takeaways: The focus is shifting from simple creation to the importance of trust.
A transition is occurring toward a curator economy.

title: Agenda
takeaways: Covers the introduction of GenAI, intelligent agents, autonomous security, and practical applications.
Addresses challenges, ethics, future trends, and required skills.

title: Today's Cybersecurity Battlefield
takeaways: Cyberattacks occur every 39 seconds worldwide.
Average cost of a data breach is $4.35M.
Ransomware payments have increased 3,900% since 2018.

title: Al Agents Hierarchy of Needs
takeaways: Highlights the hierarchy from base infrastructure and data storage up to agentic systems.
Identifies a 3.4 million security professional shortage.
Highlights 5.4 billion malware attacks in 2023.

title: The Evolution of Cyber Threats
takeaways: Traditional security relied on rule-based, manual analysis.
AI-enhanced security uses ML for patterns but requires human guidance.
Agentic AI security moves toward autonomous, proactive defense.

title: Unique Security Challenges for Startups
takeaways: Startups face resource constraints and pressure for velocity that clashes with security.
Complex cloud-native architectures increase the attack surface.
Inconsistent processes lead to significant audit readiness gaps.

title: Why Security is a Startup's Competitive Advantage
takeaways: 60% of small companies fail within 6 months of a cyber attack.
Early security investments build trust and accelerate enterprise sales.
Security acts as a market differentiator for investor confidence.

title: Automate and Codify Security Controls
takeaways: Embed policies directly into the codebase and leverage Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Deploy automated compliance and continuous monitoring (IAM, GuardDuty).
Avoid 'security theater' and prioritize meaningful, risk-reducing controls.

title: Build a Security Culture & Shared Responsibility
takeaways: Security must be a shared priority across leadership, operations, engineering, and product.
Founders should champion security as a core value.
Aligned incentives connect security goals with customer needs.

title: Real-World Example: Robin Al & Pavlov Startups
takeaways: Startups can implement SOC 2 and GDPR early without sacrificing speed.
Security compliance can function as a sales accelerator and investor signal.
Security builds trust when approached strategically from the start.

title: Secure Foundations Build Scalable Startups
takeaways: Security is a strategic enabler and growth catalyst.
Start early by automating and building a security-first culture.
Leverage proven frameworks and expert guidance to scale securely.

title: Achieving Full Agentic Systems
takeaways: Goals include self-healing systems and transparent reasoning for auditability.
Design for 'graceful failure' to prevent catastrophic outcomes.
Objective is independent, proactive defense without constant human intervention.

title: Practical Applications in Cybersecurity
takeaways: Applications include zero-day identification and pattern recognition for threat detection.
Enables automated triage, containment, and real-time forensics.
Supports secure development via code scanning and automated remediation.

title: Case Study: Autonomous Incident Response
takeaways: Financial services case showed 94% reduction in MTTR and 65% in analyst time saved.
Automated detection of ransomware in seconds enabled immediate system isolation.
Resulted in $3.2M annual savings from efficiency and breach impact reduction.

title: Organizational Risks
takeaways: Key risks include over-reliance on AI, skill gaps, and legacy infrastructure integration.
Balancing autonomous systems with human oversight remains critical.
Questions the necessity and role of 'human-in-the-loop' systems.

title: Enable Agentic Scale Without Sacrificing Systemic Integrity.
takeaways: Apply the principle of Least Privilege to limit agent permissions.
Implement memory hygiene to protect against data exfiltration and poisoning.
Continuously red-team agentic systems to anticipate adversarial inputs.

title: Infrastructure & Governance
takeaways: Deployment requires agent isolation in sandboxes to limit blast radius.
Implement secure identity management (A2A authentication) for all agents.
Ensure observability through continuous monitoring of decision logs.

title: Building a Culture of Secure Autonomy
takeaways: Shift from reactive patching to proactive, AI-specific threat modeling.
Integrate security into the full SDLC including model layers and orchestration.
Establish governance for agent discovery and behavioral monitoring.

title: Startup To-Do List: The Foundations
takeaways: Map every tool, database, and API the agent can access.
Create unique, scoped credentials; never reuse admin tokens.
Require human approval for high-impact actions like financial transactions.

title: Secure Your Future
takeaways: Integrate adversarial testing into the standard SDLC.
Adopt Zero Trust principles for agent-to-agent communications.
Shift from autonomous, silent risk to verifiable, transparent execution.

title: Emerging Trends
takeaways: Evolution toward multi-agent collaboration (2025-2026) and generative adversarial systems (2026-2027).
Focus areas: Prompt engineering, agent orchestration, AI ethics, and model evaluation.
Long-term trend toward cognitive security frameworks with multi-modal analysis.

title: Reference :
takeaways: Provides links to Hackernoon, Forbes, and LinkedIn for further reading.
Direct links to the presenter's work and professional profiles.

title: Q & A
takeaways: Open floor for questions.
Signals the conclusion of the workshop.
